title: A Finalist Chosen to Die on Mars Blew the Whistle on the Whole Mission

scenes.voiceover: A scientist chosen to die on Mars blew the whistle on the whole mission.
scenes.mainText: A FINALIST EXPOSED THE MARS MISSION

scenes.voiceover: Joseph Roche, an astrophysicist at Trinity College Dublin, was one of the hundred finalists. Then he started asking how they were really chosen.
His entire vetting to leave Earth forever, by his account? A questionnaire, a video, and a single ten minute call over Skype.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: a video call on a laptop screen

scenes.voiceover: And to climb the candidate leaderboard, Roche said, you bought merchandise and donated money. The top contenders looked like the top donors.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: a ranked leaderboard on a screen

scenes.voiceover: Mars One's founder denied it, calling the claim, quote, simply a lie. So it stays an allegation. But the whole venture collapsed in twenty nineteen.
The full investigation into Mars One is on the channel. Subscribe to mindwired.
